facts.form: V-neck, long sleeves with tubular cuffs, tubular knit bottom

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 6110 covers knitted pullovers; chapter 61 note 1 applies to made up knitted articles
GRI 6: 6110.20 of cotton; 6110.20.20 other (not 36% flax); men's, other (338)

rejected_alternatives.reason: men's sweaters (345) are coarser knit; this is a fine jersey knit pullover, as in rulings of similar goods classified outside the sweater category
sweatshirts (338) are fleece/terry-type garments, not a V-neck jersey pullover

classification.rationale: Men's 100% cotton jersey knit pullover is in heading 6110, subheading 6110.20 (of cotton). L86635 (in force) classified a similar men's cotton jersey pullover in the now-superseded 6110.20.2065 line; the current equivalent is 6110.20.20.69 (men's, other, 338). Suffix is a judgement between sweater and other pullover.
